pages.text: $(thing)Artifact of the Movement Path.$(br2)Right-click on a mob to catch it. A short right-click releases the mob where you are looking, while holding right-click for 5 seconds absorbs it: health goes to you, the remainder becomes hunger.
pages.title: Soul Catcher

pages.text: You cannot catch bosses and mobs with over 50 hearts.$(br2)Shift + Right-click on a block to place the Soul Catcher. With a caught mob, it glows. A broken catcher returns the item along with the mob.
